api_safety.backward_compatibility: Corrects reversive vowel selection to source vowel copy. Breaking: the old u/o-only -unur-/-onor- generation (e.g. pfekunura) no longer generates or analyzes; legacy styles long_urur/urur/oror/long_unur/unur/onor are rejected with 422 guidance. The old short -ur-/-or- form is evidence-gated: generation returns 422 EXTENSION_UNVERIFIED and inferred analyses exclude the derivation (exact reviewed entries still resolve).

counterexamples.note: Violates vowel copy (e-radical requires -enur-); the analyzer returns 422.
-oror- is the repetitive extension (own card), not a reversive; requesting it as reversive style long_urur/urur/oror returns 422 pointing at repetitive.

notes: The first vowel of the reversive extension copies the radical vowel while the second is /u/, save after /o/ when it is /o/.
Finite forms (e.g. ndinopfekenura) are constructed combinations of these attested radicals with the supported present construction.
Vowelless (C) radicals have no stated reversive allomorph; generation on them returns 422.
The short -ur-/-or- allomorph is evidence-gated (see the retained card): generation refuses it and inferred analyses exclude it; surfaces resolve only as their own reviewed lemmas.

qa.reviewer_notes: All five radical pairs verified by visual inspection of the local PDF page. Corrects the previous u/o-only implementation and the reversive/repetitive conflation.

rule_summary: Reversive extension with vowel copy: -anur- / -enur- / -inur- / -onor- / -unur-, where the first vowel matches the radical vowel (a/e/i/o/u) and the second is /u/ (or /o/ after /o/).
source_locator: Fortune, Shona Grammatical Constructions Vol. 1 (1985), section 2.10.2.3.3 'Extended radicals', PDF p. 33 (printed p. 21), paragraph (c)
title: Reversive extension with vowel copy
